Hi all,

  please review this change to the `TestHumongousFullGCLeak.java` test to make it more stable.

Concurrent mark can allocate additional card set memory, which can cause wrong readings.

The suggested fix is to make the built-in card set memory reclaimer very aggressive, and give it some time to reclaim memory.

Note that I could not by myself verify the reported issue.

Testing: gha, fixed test
